messages.content: Bend is squared away. Nebraska just landed on my calendar: distributor training Tuesday afternoon and an operator demo Wednesday morning. Can you build the flight, hotel, and car shortlist? Omaha is obvious, but check Kansas City only if it is meaningfully cheaper. One connection max.
I can. What dates and fixed windows should I use, and are you carrying the training cases or are they being shipped to the distributor?

Plan for Monday Aug 10 in, Wednesday Aug 12 out if possible. Training is Tuesday 1:00 to 4:30 at the distributor in west Omaha. Wednesday demo is 8:00 to 11:30 somewhere in the metro; manager debrief may go after lunch. Cases may arrive Monday, but I do not know who signs.

Initial flight read: Omaha is the better working airport. Best fit if you want Monday evening prep is SFO-OMA with one Denver connection, leaving late morning or early afternoon and landing around 6:00 to 7:00 p.m. Acceptable later option is a United SFO-DEN-OMA itinerary around 1:30 p.m. landing near 9:00, but that cuts into dinner and slide review. Delta via Minneapolis can be a backup in a similar one-stop range. Kansas City only helps if the fare gap is large; MCI-to-Omaha is about 2 hours 45 minutes to 3 hours 10 minutes before stops.
If the cases need a signature, the local rep can probably handle it. I mainly need time Monday night to eat and run through slides. I do not want a midnight drive from Kansas City.

Then I’d downgrade Kansas City to a price check, not a real plan. For Omaha, use an airport-terminal rental pickup Monday evening. Car class depends on the cases: compact is fine if they stay at the distributor, but a midsize SUV is safer if a Pelican case or demo kit ends up with you.
Hotel areas?

Three useful zones: west Omaha or Aksarben for the Tuesday distributor commute; Old Market or riverfront for restaurants and possibly the Wednesday municipal site; airport or Carter Lake for the easiest landing night but weakest dinner logistics. I would not lead with the airport unless price is much better.
Which area would you pick before we know the Wednesday site?

West Omaha/Aksarben is the best fit while Tuesday is the only fixed address. It should keep you 10–15 minutes from the distributor and still reasonable to most metro utilities. Riverfront is the acceptable backup if Wednesday turns out to be across the river or downtown. Airport is mostly a budget backup.
Check parking and dinner specifically. I’ll have a rental, not rideshare.

Aksarben: usually straightforward surface or garage parking, and dinner is walkable around the village. West Dodge/Regency: easy parking, more chain or short-drive dinners. Old Market/riverfront: best dinner access, but parking often means paid garage or valet. Airport: free parking is common, but dinner usually means driving.
I do not need fancy. Guest rating above 4 is enough. Room should have coffee and a mini-fridge if we can get it.

Shortlist based on that: Hilton Garden Inn Omaha Aksarben Village, strong practical fit with 4-plus guest ratings, parking access, restaurant/bar or nearby dinners, and rooms that typically cover coffee and fridge. Marriott Omaha Regency is another west-side option with easy parking but less walkable dining. Hyatt Place Omaha/Downtown-Old Market gives better dinner access and likely fridge/coffee, with paid parking. I’d skip the high-end riverfront properties unless rates are unusually low.
Is there a Southwest option from Oakland worth comparing?

Worth a fare check, yes. Southwest from OAK to OMA is usually a one-stop or connecting option through Denver, Vegas, or Phoenix and can land in the 7:30 to 8:30 p.m. range. Trade-off is no assigned seat in advance and sometimes less clean receipt handling. It is acceptable if the fare is materially better, but SFO-OMA via Denver looks cleaner for schedule control.
Keep Southwest as a fare check, not first pick. What car class would you actually hold?

Midsize SUV. It is usually not much more than a compact for a two-day rental, and it protects you if the training cases move with you or the municipal site has uneven parking. Pick up and return at OMA; I would avoid off-airport rentals for this one.
Return is the messy part. What are the windows if the debrief happens or does not happen?

If you are done by about 1:00 Wednesday, target OMA departures around 5:15 to 6:00 p.m. via Denver, Chicago, or Minneapolis, getting you back to SFO around 9:30 to 10:30. If the debrief runs closer to 3:00, Wednesday becomes rushed after the drive, fuel, car return, and airport buffer. In that case, Thursday morning is the safer return.
Package this as best fit and backup. I need to send it to Laura.

Best fit pending the Wednesday address: SFO-OMA Monday with one connection, landing by about 6:00 to 7:00; midsize SUV at OMA; Aksarben or west Omaha hotel with 4-plus guest rating, workable parking, dinner nearby, and coffee/fridge confirmed if possible. Backup: Old Market/riverfront hotel if Wednesday is downtown or across the river; Southwest from OAK only if the fare is meaningfully better; Kansas City only if savings are large and the arrival still avoids a late drive.
Also note that Monday evening prep time matters. Do not let the Kansas City option creep back in because it saves fifty bucks.

Noted. I’ll keep Kansas City as a price-check only, not a working itinerary unless the savings are substantial and the timing still protects Monday dinner and prep. Open items before booking: case-signature owner, Wednesday facility address, and whether the manager debrief ends near lunch or midafternoon.

memory_annotations.evidence_summary: Jonah narrowed the trip to SFO-OMA, no landing after 9 p.m., practical Old Market/riverfront hotel over a splurge, OMA terminal midsize SUV, and holding the return until the Wednesday ride-along end time is known.

messages.content: Update on Nebraska: the training case is confirmed for Monday noon at the distributor, and their warehouse manager is signing. Wednesday demo moved across the river, with a 7:30 gate arrival. Narrow this down.

That pushes the hotel choice toward Old Market or riverfront. It gives you an easier early run across the river Wednesday and better dinner options Monday and Tuesday. West Omaha is still acceptable, but the 7:30 gate would mean a longer morning drive.
What outbound would you choose if I do not need to touch the case Monday?

Use SFO-OMA with one connection and avoid Kansas City. I’d choose a Monday itinerary landing around 6:00 to 6:30 p.m. so you still have dinner and prep time. The later 9:00-ish Omaha arrival works on paper but is not the best fit for being sharp Tuesday.
Do not land after 9. I need to be functional Tuesday. SFO is fine.

Then first choice is United SFO-DEN-OMA Monday, departing late morning and arriving Omaha around 6:15 with a reasonable Denver connection. Backup is Delta via Minneapolis landing around 7:30 if the fare or seat map is better. I’d set car pickup at OMA for about 6:30 and hold a midsize SUV.
Hotel: any reason not to use riverfront now?

Only cost and parking. Riverfront or Old Market may add a paid garage, often around $25–35 a night, and Tuesday’s west Omaha commute is about 25 minutes. But Wednesday’s 7:30 gate is much cleaner, and dinner logistics are better. I’d pick a practical 4-plus-rated Old Market property, not the splurge option.
Use the practical one. Make sure parking is workable.

Practical pick: Hyatt Place Omaha/Downtown-Old Market if the rate is reasonable. It has nearby garage parking, easy dinner access, breakfast, and rooms that usually include a mini-fridge and coffee setup. Backup: Hilton Garden Inn Old Market/Riverfront if Hyatt pricing or parking looks worse.
Return is still the problem. Ride-along may end at 1 or closer to 3.

If it ends at 1:00, book a Wednesday evening OMA-SFO return via Denver or Chicago around 5:20 to 6:00 p.m.; leave the site by 2:15 and return the car by 3:30. If it ends near 3:00, do not force it. Book Thursday morning around 7:30 to 8:15 and keep the evening sane.
Can we book the outbound, hotel, and car now, and wait on the return?

Yes. Book the Monday SFO-OMA one-stop landing around 6:15, midsize SUV at OMA, and the practical Old Market/riverfront hotel on a refundable rate. Leave the return unbooked until the ride-along end time is confirmed. Ask before booking only if parking is unusually painful or the hotel cannot confirm the mini-fridge and coffee setup.
